name: Wound
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as physical damage once.

name: Enflame
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as fire damage once.

name: Poison
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as earth damage once.

name: Freeze
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as ice damage once.

name: Zap
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as energy damage once.

name: Curse
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as death damage once.

name: Cripple
description: Cripples the creature with a certain chance and paralyzes it for 10 seconds.

name: Parry
description: Any damage taken is reflected to the aggressor with a certain chance.

name: Dodge
description: Dodges an attack with a certain chance without taking any damage at all.

name: Adrenaline Burst
description: Bursts of adrenaline enhance your reflexes with a certain chance after you get hit and let you move faster for 10 seconds.

name: Numb
description: Numbs the creature with a certain chance after its attack and paralyzes the creature for 10 seconds.

name: Cleanse
description: Cleanses you from within with a certain chance after you get hit and removes one random active negative status effect and temporarily makes you immune against it.

name: Bless
description: Blesses you and reduces skill and xp loss by 10% when killed by the chosen creature.

name: Scavenge
description: Enhances your chances to successfully skin/dust a skinnable/dustable creature.

name: Gut
description: Gutting the creature yields 20% more creature products.

name: Low Blow
description: Adds 8% critical hit chance to attacks with critical hit weapons.

name: Divine Wrath
description: Triggers on a creature with a certain chance and deals 5% of its initial hit points as holy damage once.

name: Vampiric Embrace
description: Adds 4% Life Leech to attacks if wearing equipment that provides life leech.

name: Void's Call
description: Adds 2% Mana Leech to attacks if wearing equipment that provides mana leech.

name: Savage Blow
description: Adds critical extra damage to attacks with critical hit weapons.

name: Fatal Hold
description: Prevents creatures from fleeing due to low health for 30 seconds.

name: Void Inversion
description: Chance to gain mana instead of losing it when taking Mana Drain damage.

name: Carnage
description: Killing a monster deals physical damage to others in a small radius.

name: Overpower
description: Deals physical damage based on your maximum health.

name: Overflux
description: Deals physical damage based on your maximum mana.
